name: Dutse State Secretariat & Civic Complex
description: The administrative citadel of Jigawa State along Kiyawa Road. Home to government ministries, civil service commissions, executive council chambers, and official state protocol.

name: Federal University Dutse (FUD)
description: Vibrant federal university campus bustling with undergraduate students, academic lecture halls, tech innovation labs, mobile POS agents, and lively student cafeterias.
economicSpecialty: Fintech / POS Micro-cash, Graphic Design & Quick Student Services

name: Kasuwar Dutse (Ultra-Modern Market & Grain Depot)
hausaName: Babban Kasuwar Dutse da Ma'ajiyar Hatsi
description: The beating commercial heart of Dutse. Vibrant market stalls overflowing with sesame, sorted rice, dried fish, textiles, spices, and busy mobile money POS operators.
economicSpecialty: Sesame & Grain Trading, Smoked River Fish Wholesale & Livestock Auctions

name: Fadar Sarkin Dutse (Emir's Palace & Garu Citadel)
description: Historic royal seat of the Emir of Dutse nestled at the base of the granite hills. Celebrated for ornate Hausa Tubali architecture, Durbar horse pageantry, and council elders.
economicSpecialty: Mutunci Cultural Diplomacy, Durbar Equestrian Pageantry & Traditional Crafts

name: Dutse Rock Summit & Innovation Hub
hausaName: Dutsen Dutse da Cibiyar Fasahar Sadarwa
description: The towering granite inselberg overlooking Dutse, crowned by telecom relay towers, hiking lookouts, solar power arrays, and the Jigawa ICT Innovation Hub.
economicSpecialty: Dam Irrigation Engineering, Solar Power Maintenance & Date Farming
